narrative.overview: A quiet native instrument drawn by hand. Original black linework gives every primary surface an unmistakably human point of view while the operating interface stays precise, spacious, and native.
keyCharacteristics: One purposeful doodle per primary surface
Colour concentrated in authored scenes and known interruption origins
Premium finish through crop, spacing, type, and motion

rules.name: Quiet Focus, Warm Interruption
rules.body: Focus reverses between ink and paper; known interruption origins use coral, violet, or amber.

rules.name: One Raised Surface
rules.body: Use spacing and dividers before nesting cards.

dos: Keep the current intention and next action more prominent than metrics.
Lead each primary surface with one purposeful illustration, companion, or annotation from the original line-art world.
Make doodles feel premium through deliberate crops, stable line weight, native typography, generous negative space, and verified transparency.
donts: Do not turn the day into an adherence score.
Do not infer a cause from artwork or model prose alone.
Do not scatter multiple cartoons across one operating screen or turn a doodle into a control or substitute for data.
Do not frame a doodle in a generic card to disguise a baked background or rough edge.
